research_policy.name: CONSERVATIVE_PROP_FIRM_NEWS_EXCLUSION
research_policy.description: Research gate: do not allow candidate entries/exits inside high-impact news windows even when a target prop-firm account type would technically allow or merely haircut news profits.
research_policy.bar_intersection_rule: A bar is news-contaminated when its half-open interval [open, close) overlaps the closed policy window [event-pre, event+post].
research_policy.promotion_rule: Any strategy candidate using rows inside the conservative news mask is ineligible for prop-firm promotion.

FUNDEDNEXT_CFD_CHALLENGE.note: Stellar 1-Step, 2-Step and Lite challenge phases are currently excluded from the funded-account news reward-share rule.

FUNDEDNEXT_CFD_FUNDED.note: Current FundedNext CFD funded-account policy applies a 40% reward-share treatment to profitable trades executed in the listed high-impact news window; the research policy remains stricter and blocks these windows entirely.

FTMO_EVALUATION.note: Current FTMO Evaluation Process has no news restriction, subject to forbidden-trading-practice rules.

FTMO_FUNDED_STANDARD.note: Current FTMO Standard funded-account rule restricts opening/closing targeted instruments around selected macro releases; XAUUSD is affected by selected USD events. The research policy is intentionally broader: all high-impact USD events +/-5 minutes.

FTMO_FUNDED_SWING.note: Current FTMO Swing account has no news restriction, but the conservative research mask still applies.

research_chronology.xau_research_source_requirement: Use the same MT5 terminal/server-time basis for Phase I-B XAU history as Phase I-A calendar export, avoiding historical timezone-conversion ambiguity.
